identity.name: PowerShell History File Access via Unusual Process
identity.summary: An attacker uses a non-standard process to access the PowerShell history file for credential theft. Cortex should detect the unusual access pattern to the history file.
identity.description: An attacker uses a non-standard process to access the PowerShell history file for credential theft. Cortex should detect the unusual access pattern to the history file.

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Unusual Process Accessed PowerShell History
biocs.description: A process not typically associated with PowerShell history access attempts to read the history file.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.FILE_ACCESS and action_file_path = 'C:\\Users\\user\\AppData\\Roaming\\Microsoft\\Windows\\PowerShell\\PSReadLine\\ConsoleHost_history.txt'
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'powershell.exe' and actor_process_image_name != 'cmd.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'powershell.exe'
